title: Feedback-08: isolated ten-substep carry and accepted-wall regression gate

manual_steps: No owner testing or configuration action is required. Continue isolated validation autonomously; do not launch a client, package, install or alter owner worlds, processes, launch settings or configuration.
This remains diagnostic configuration validation, not production adoption, performance acceptance, M1 acceptance or permission to advance M2-M6.
If the regression gate passes, the next task is a controlled headless server-cost comparison before proposing any production setting change. Preserve default-two failure evidence.
